run_prepare_amass_data: run the script to preprocess AMASS motion capture data into PyTorch tensors for BioMotionLab, CMU, and MPI_HDM05 datasets
build_body_model_from_smplh: build a BodyModel instance from SMPLH and DMPL model files with configurable beta and DMPL parameters
create_rotation_features_from_poses: create 6D rotation representations and rotation velocity features from AMASS pose axis-angle data
extract_head_transforms_from_mocap: extract head joint global transformation matrices from motion capture sequences using the SMPLH body model
save_processed_mocap_tensors: save processed motion capture data including body parameters, joint positions, and rotations as PyTorch files
